cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?
